انتكست (form VIII)
# اِنْتَكَسْتُ (intakastu) /in.ta.kas.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# اِنْتَكَسْتَ (intakasta) /in.ta.kas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# اِنْتَكَسْتِ (intakasti) /in.ta.kas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# اِنْتَكَسَتْ (intakasat) /in.ta.ka.sat/: third-perso
